544:t_2:171.en:
$$レナード$$
「She is the convergence point of cause and effect. You could say she is who she is because this world went wrong...」

544:t_2:172.en:
$$レナード$$
「Or you could say this world went wrong because she exists.」

544:t_2:174.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$ will meet a ghost in the deepest part of these ruins. Inevitably.」

544:t_2:175.en:
$$レナード$$
「There she will unite with the power to put an end to history.」

544:t_2:177.en:
$$レナード$$
「She'll become the keystone that creates a world without past, future, or present... Literally, the linchpin - $$カナメ$$.」

544:t_2:178.en:
$$宗介$$
「I do not understand. What are you talking about?」

544:t_2:179.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm talking about the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ and the whispers. The world's chaos began here.」

544:t_2:184.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...The deeper I go, the more these strange feelings come over me...)

544:t_2:185.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I don't focus my mind clearly on what's ahead, I'll lose my sanity...)

544:t_2:186.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you all right, $$カナメ$$?」

544:t_2:187.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, $$テッサ$$... Do we really have to go?」

544:t_2:188.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We must do something before $$アマルガム$$ uses this place.」

544:t_2:190.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It has enough power to toy with the fate of everyone in the world if mishandled.」

544:t_2:191.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ probably only pretended to obey the Empire because he could use this to overturn the situation.」

544:t_2:192.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Is that strange feeling because of it too?」

544:t_2:193.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... It is probably inactive now, but it is the effect of Dr. $$ヴァロフ$$'s research device up ahead.」

544:t_2:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「An inactive device has an effect...?」

544:t_2:195.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The psychic waves from when it operated at full power 18 years ago are reaching this era.」

544:t_2:196.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Psychic waves come from the past...?」

544:t_2:198.en:
$$テッサ$$
「While the world was still unstable after the $$大時空震動$$, what shaped the world called $$ＡＤＷ$$... and now this world, began here.」

544:t_2:199.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm starting to understand... what's ahead of us...」

544:t_2:201.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... Humanity entered a forbidden realm to control $$時空震動$$... in other words, $$次元力|lc$$...」

544:t_2:203.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They controlled $$次元力|lc$$... by amplifying psychic waves...」

544:t_2:204.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It neared completion through repeated experiments on human beings.」

544:t_2:205.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But during a full-power test 18 years ago, $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ ran out of control...」

544:t_2:206.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All of $$ヤムスク１１$$ suffered mental contamination. The town became a ruin, a place that kept outsiders away.」

544:t_2:207.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So that's why this town ended up like this...」

544:t_2:208.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There were several types of psychic waves emitted through the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:209.en:
$$テッサ$$
「One was the Iota wave that contaminated $$ヤムスク１１$$'s residents... It weakens with increasing distance and time.」

544:t_2:210.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Another was the Tau wave. Regardless of distance and time, this psychic wave travels far without weakening.」

544:t_2:211.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Tau waves barely harmed ordinary people, but we believe they spread across the entire Earth.」

544:t_2:212.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But no one noticed... you mean.」

544:t_2:213.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes, because they could not be physically observed. But some people were exceptions.」

544:t_2:214.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ ran out of control on December 24, 18 years ago...」

544:t_2:215.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's... the day I was born...!」

544:t_2:216.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is also my birthday, $$レナード$$'s... and $$バニ$$'s and $$ミラ$$'s.」

544:t_2:219.en:
$$テッサ$$
「When $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ ran out of control 18 years ago, Tau waves spread around the world for only about three minutes.」

544:t_2:221.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those children are us... the $$ウィスパード$$.」

544:t_2:222.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So in those three minutes, all that knowledge called Black Technology was put into our heads?」

544:t_2:224.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I believe we were given the ability to receive other psychic waves sent from some future through the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:226.en:
$$テッサ$$
「In the $$オムニ・スフィア$$, information can travel backward through time.」

544:t_2:227.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are receiving information sent from the future, rather than possessing unknown technical knowledge from birth.」

544:t_2:228.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What was imprinted at birth was probably the minimum ability needed to receive it.」

544:t_2:229.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then some technologies and weapons were created from that technical information from the future?」

544:t_2:230.en:
$$テッサ$$
「ASes are the most striking example.」

544:t_2:231.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They are mobile weapons born from a system entirely different from conventional technology... with many revolutionary technologies accompanying them...」

544:t_2:232.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those things probably could not have existed in the original world.」

544:t_2:233.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Those small weapons... are proof of the world's distortion...」

544:t_2:234.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They are unusual even among the many possibilities brought about by the $$大時空震動$$...」

544:t_2:235.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The world transformed by that should be called a temporal disaster... a $$タイムハザード$$.」

544:t_2:236.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I do not know if an original history truly exists in the first place, though...」

544:t_2:238.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If the $$ウィスパード$$'s emergence and the $$オムニ・スフィア$$'s interference were inevitable, this could have been natural all along.」

544:t_2:240.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That is a world without ASes... Then $$宗介$$ would...)

544:t_2:241.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Up ahead may be dangerous even for the $$ウィスパード$$. Please wait here, $$カナメ$$.」

544:t_2:242.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's waiting up ahead, isn't it...」

544:t_2:243.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The place that twisted our fate...」

544:t_2:251.en:
$$レナード$$
「That is how the current world... the world distorted by $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ running out of control, was born.」

544:t_2:252.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That is absurd. Something like that...」

544:t_2:253.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're free not to believe it.」

544:t_2:254.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is not what I mean.」

544:t_2:255.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am saying it is absurd for you to arbitrarily decide this world is distorted.」

544:t_2:240: Kaname leaves the consequence for Sousuke unfinished while imagining a world without ASes.
544:t_2:242: Kaname dislocates the subject to row243; this row refers ahead with It.
544:t_2:243: Delayed subject names the place from row242, retaining the source row cut.
544:t_2:250: Sousuke trails off in disbelief before Leonard summarizes the origin of the world.
544:t_2:252: Sousuke begins a second objection with Something like that but leaves it unfinished.
uncertain: 544:t_2:177: Adapted Kaname/keystone pun with linchpin and name; no-past/future/present world clause retained.
544:t_2:203: Amplifying psychic waves is the means of controlling dimensional power; same-row clauses attached.
